title: One Soul One Struggle: Region and Revolution in Indonesia (Anton E. Lucas)
comment:
This publication is a study of the Indonesian revolution at the grass-roots level. Focus on the Three Regions Affair (Indonesia) (Tiga Daerah) in Pekalongan in northern Central Java in 1945. More than 350 participants in the Three Regions Affair (Indonesia) were interviewed by the author. Published by Allen and Unwin in association with Asian Studies Association of Australia Southeast Asia Publications Series No. 19.
Source: Anton Lucas Collection (Flinders University Library)
